Module com.codependentvariables.aiandme
Package com.codependentvariables.aiandme.controller

Class PuzzleLibraryController

java.lang.Object
com.codependentvariables.aiandme.controller.QuizController
com.codependentvariables.aiandme.controller.PuzzleLibraryController
public class PuzzleLibraryController extends QuizController
Controller for the Puzzle Library screen. Reuses quiz-library.fxml which is the same layout as the Quiz Library. Puzzle is a type of quiz and will be added here, separating the logic.
